title: A Taxonomy of Failing Bug Reproduction Tests on SWT-Bench
abstract: arXiv:2611.13395v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic Program Repair (APR) tools require high-quality test generation models to validate candidate patches. Despite the advancements of automated bug reproduction testing tools, they continue to struggle with issues of higher complexity. These struggles may be caused by a framework's lack of problem-specific context. We address the unclassified nature of these framework failures by providing a taxonomy of bug reproduction tests. This study uses the AssertFlip and OpenHands frameworks, the two highest-scoring open-source tools on SWT-Bench Verified. The significance of model selection on the causes of failure is also explored by utilizing GPT-5-mini and GPT-4o-mini on both tools. The error traces of these frameworks are categorized to determine granular modes of failure. Through this process, mechanical and implementation failures were the most common failure classes. translated_title: SWT-Bench上失败缺陷复现测试的分类体系
translated_abstract: 自动程序修复（APR）工具需要高质量的测试生成模型来验证候选补丁。尽管自动化缺陷复现测试工具已取得进展，但它们在处理更高复杂度的问题时仍然面临困难。这些困难可能源于框架缺乏针对特定问题的上下文信息。我们通过提供一套缺陷复现测试失败的分类体系，来解决这些框架失败一直未被系统分类的问题。本研究使用了AssertFlip和OpenHands这两个框架，它们是SWT-Bench Verified上得分最高的开源工具。研究还通过在这两个工具上分别使用GPT-5-mini和GPT-4o-mini，探讨了模型选择对失败原因的重要影响。研究对这些框架的错误轨迹进行了分类，以确定细粒度的失败模式。通过这一过程，发现机械性失败和实现性失败是最常见的失败类别。总体而言，工具的生成方法对……
tldr: 该研究首次针对SWT-Bench Verified上得分最高的两个开源框架（AssertFlip和OpenHands）的缺陷复现测试失败情况建立了分类体系，发现机械性失败和实现性失败是最常见的失败类别，且模型选择和生成方法对失败原因有显著影响。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first taxonomy of failing bug reproduction tests on SWT-Bench Verified by categorizing error traces from the two top-scoring open-source frameworks (AssertFlip and OpenHands), finding that mechanical and implementation failures are the most common failure classes, and that model selection and a tool's generation approach significantly impact failure causes.
